sql: select ep.epoch_number, ep.ended_at as epoch_ended, d.deployment_key, d.started_at, d.ended_at as dep_ended, string_agg(a.strategy_tag, ',' order by a.strategy_tag) as tags from experiment_deployments d join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id = d.epoch_id join experiment_versions v on v.id = ep.version_id join experiments e on e.id = v.experiment_id left join experiment_deployment_arms a on a.deployment_id = d.id where e.key = 'mmsell-type-tight' group by 1,2,3,4,5 order by ep.epoch_number, d.deployment_key
